findings.text: verdict.measured == 5.0e-2 and verdict.bound == 1.0e-2 (lines 490-491), and verdict.measured == "diverted" / verdict.bound == "limited" (lines 548-549), compare the predicate's echo of the clause back to the literal the test itself passed in; ClauseVerdict copies Clause.measured and Clause.bound through unchanged, so these four assertions hold whatever the predicate does with the value and cannot catch the regression. The independent guard in each test is the failing_clauses assertion at line 488 / 536 / 546, which does fail if the clause stops being judged.

GLOBAL_RESIDUAL and COMPILE_COST are required families for every kind yet no test drives either past its bound and expects a refusal: every refusal test exercises a constraint-row, null-position, map-fidelity, support-stability or boundary-class clause, and the strong-1000 test asserts only that boundary_level names the refusal while compile cost fails incidentally without being asserted. A regression specific to how the global residual or the executable-size clause is judged would leave the suite green, so the clause the design exists to refuse on is the one whose refusal is unproven at the predicate level.
